confidence_notes: I ran three web searches: one for the RBA rate and two for Brno prices. The price searches returned crowd-sourced aggregates (MyLifeElsewhere, Traveltables, Expatistan) that disagree with each other, and some pages are dated (Traveltables July 2023, Expatistan June 2025). I rounded up from these figures to allow for restaurant and tourist-area pricing. The Brno cocktail figure (about $7) comes from a thin Expatistan sample. I found no direct glass-of-wine price, so I estimated wine at roughly 1.3x the domestic draft beer price, using the usual Czech relationship between the two. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Brno and comparable Central European cities. I did not search accommodation prices or inspect any listings. They are the least certain anchors, and prices vary by season and event, for example trade fairs and the Grand Prix.
comparable_city_reasoning: Brno is the Czech Republic's second city. Its restaurant prices run slightly below Prague's, and it is a university and trade-fair city with modest tourist pricing. It is comparable to other mid-sized Central European cities such as Ostrava, Plzeň, Bratislava and Kraków. Accommodation is cheaper than Prague, Vienna or Budapest.
